name: kimi-desktop-personal-agent
description: Kimi desktop personal agent — voice-first home, self-evolving workbench, ACP client for kimi-code CLI
author: AlbertYang

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:renderer: esbuild src/renderer/ball/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/ball/index.js --format=iife && esbuild src/renderer/chat/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/chat/index.js --format=iife && esbuild src/renderer/workbench/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/workbench/index.js --format=iife && esbuild src/renderer/home/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/home/index.js --format=iife && cp src/renderer/ball/index.html src/renderer/ball/style.css dist/renderer/ball/ && cp src/renderer/chat/index.html src/renderer/chat/style.css dist/renderer/chat/ && cp src/renderer/workbench/index.html src/renderer/workbench/style.css dist/renderer/workbench/ && cp src/renderer/home/index.html dist/renderer/home/ && mkdir -p dist/renderer/preview dist/renderer/focus-pill && cp src/renderer/preview/index.html dist/renderer/preview/ && cp src/renderer/focus-pill/index.html dist/renderer/focus-pill/ && esbuild src/renderer/todo-panel/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/todo-panel/index.js --format=iife && cp src/renderer/todo-panel/index.html dist/renderer/todo-panel/ && mkdir -p dist/renderer/shared && cp src/renderer/shared/chat-panel.css dist/renderer/shared/ && cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css dist/renderer/shared/ && esbuild src/renderer/remote/app.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/remote/app.js --format=iife && cp src/renderer/remote/index.html src/renderer/remote/style.css dist/renderer/remote/ && cp src/renderer/shared/chat-panel.css dist/renderer/remote/ && cp assets/avatar.png dist/renderer/remote/ && mkdir -p dist/renderer/remote/vendor dist/renderer/remote/assets/moon dist/renderer/remote/assets/reference && cp src/renderer/remote/vendor/three.min.js dist/renderer/remote/vendor/ && cp src/renderer/remote/assets/moon/*.jpg dist/renderer/remote/assets/moon/ && cp src/renderer/remote/assets/reference/*.jpg dist/renderer/remote/assets/reference/
